sloka: लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजा भर्तुस्ते ऽनुचरः प्रियः ।कृतवाञ्छोकसन्तप्तः शिरसा ते ऽभिवादनम् ।। ५.३४.४।।।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaśca mahātejā bhartuste 'nucaraḥ priyaḥ ।kṛtavāñchokasantaptaḥ śirasā te 'bhivādanam ।। 5.34.4।।।।

translations.english: "The mighty Lakshmana too, a dear brother and follower of your husband is immersed in grief, and sends salutations to you."
